subject: Pilot paused by connector issue — request for extension + sandbox credit
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cargoai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@cargoai.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot blocked: webhook connector failing during staging ingest

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our engineering team — after importing the first batch of test data into the CargoAI staging account yesterday we hit an intermittent failure in the SFTP-to-Redwood connector. The failure shows up as a 502 gateway error during the initial handshake; we tried with a reduced payload and still see occasional timeouts.

This has effectively paused our pilot workstream (we can't run the eval prompts or integrate with our downstream parser). Our engineers estimate a 4–6 day fix unless we escalate. Given the timeline, can Redwood consider a short extension to the pilot window and a small sandbox/top-up so our engineers can re-run the end-to-end tests once the fix is in? We don't want to lose momentum.

Attaching the connector logs and a brief mapping doc.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
CTO, CargoAI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cargoai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked: webhook connector failing during staging ingest

Hi Samir — thanks for the logs, and sorry you hit this.

Ben — looping you in for the commercial ask (extension + sandbox top-up). Laura — can you triage onboarding side and see whether we can repro in our QA environment?

Samir, quick reassurance: we aim to be flexible here. We typically treat connector-induced pauses as valid grounds for pilot extensions, especially when there's a clear engineering dependency. To move quickly we'll need: 1) an ETA from your engineers on the fix, and 2) any additional logs if the error recurs after a retry.

If it helps we'll provision a temporary sandbox carryover (small token grant) so you can validate once the connector is stable. Ben — can you outline an approval path and an amount that maps to a 1-week breathing room?

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimmie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked: webhook connector failing during staging ingest

Kimberly / team,

I pulled the logs Samir attached and repro'd a similar handshake timeout against a local replica. The symptom looks like a race during the SFTP session initialization when the remote server responds with a delayed banner; our connector retry window is short and we drop the connection.

Workaround: increase the socket timeout and add a 2s backoff on the initial handshake — low-risk change but it will require a rolling patch and QA run. Estimate: 1 business day for the patch, plus 1 day for staging validation and another day for re-run of their end-to-end testcases (3 days total).

If CargoAI wants a faster path, we can schedule a joint troubleshooting session today and attempt a targeted config change, but that depends on their ability to open remote debug access.

I recommend approving a 5-calendar-day extension and a small sandbox token top-up so they can iterate without hitting quota during the re-test. Happy to join any call with Samir's team.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cargoai.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked: webhook connector failing during staging ingest

Samir — appreciate the details and the patience. Approving the request:

- Pilot extension: +7 calendar days (new pilot expiry: 2026-07-05)
- Sandbox/top-up: 50k tokens added to your staging account (visible in the Console under Trial Credits)
- Engineering support: Karthik will be on standby for a joint session; Kimberly will coordinate times.

Please confirm that the extension and top-up cover your immediate needs, and let us know if you'd like Redwood to run the targeted config change (we can schedule a remote debug window).

Ben Carter
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-0199
